headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of August 21, 2026, the portfolio is demonstrating a strong performance with an average return of 24.69%, significantly surpassing the SPY benchmark return of 12.85%. This results in an average alpha of 11.84%, indicating that the portfolio is not only growing in absolute terms but also outperforming the broader market. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved an impressive return of 46.84%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 10.87%, highlighting the variability within the portfolio set. Outperforming SPY during this period can signal resilience amid market fluctuations and uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
